title: Which driver had the highest average points in the 2007 season among those
question: Which driver had the highest average points in the 2007 season among those who scored points in both the Canadian and United States Grand Prix that year?

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_drivers AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_075
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    WHERE ra.XCL_066 = 2007
      AND ra.XCL_069 IN ('Canadian Grand Prix', 'United States Grand Prix')
      AND r.XCL_082 > 0
    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ra.XCL_069) = 2
)
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075
JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
WHERE ra.XCL_066 = 2007
  AND d.XCL_034 IN (SELECT XCL_075 FROM qualifying_drivers)
GROUP BY d.XCL_034, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
ORDER BY AVG(r.XCL_082) DESC
LIMIT 1

structural_constraints.description: Participation in the second qualifying session (Q2) implies participation in the first qualifying session (Q1). The data confirms this: every row with a Q2 time has a Q1 time, but many rows with a Q1 time do not have a Q2 time.

Participation in the third qualifying session (Q3) implies participation in the second qualifying session (Q2). The data confirms this: every row with a Q3 time has a Q2 time, but many rows with a Q2 time do not have a Q3 time.

eligibility_lowering.pre_lowering_sql:
WITH qualifying_drivers AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_075
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    WHERE ra.XCL_066 = 2007
      AND ra.XCL_069 IN ('Canadian Grand Prix', 'United States Grand Prix')
      AND r.XCL_082 > 0
    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ra.XCL_069) = 2
)
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075
JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
WHERE ra.XCL_066 = 2007
  AND d.XCL_034 IN (SELECT XCL_075 FROM qualifying_drivers)
GROUP BY d.XCL_034, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
ORDER BY AVG(r.XCL_082) DESC
LIMIT 1
